comment: All candidates shared Adagrad and a modest progress proxy (Δ≈0.032), so optimizer differences did not determine the order. K1020 favored the heavily normalized A and C; both also normalize their final hidden block, consistent with K1061’s adaptive spiral evidence. A’s extra normalization favored it over C. The zero-LN ordering B<D<E was less strongly supported: residual connections alone did not outweigh B’s plain architecture, while D’s deeper GELU recipe beat shallow E. K1016 helped avoid selecting the widest model. K1066 was only indirectly relevant because neither deep normalized candidate was residual. This result adds no isolated, generalizable effect.
